藏品名称_ZN: 青花人物诸葛碗（长春万古款）
描述_EN: Blue and white bowl with figures of Zhuge（Changchun Vanguard），Ming Longqing, reign name of Qing dynasty province in northwest China, adjacent Liaoning，your (honorific)7.9centimetre，caliber14.2centimetre，footsteps7.4centimetre。　　The bowl is a reclining shallow dish with a pier-type bowl stacked on top of each other.。Hollow bowl，The sole of the foot is connected by a round hole。Bowl decorated with blue and white flowers，Painted inside the bowl“Zhao Jun goes out of the Frontiers of the Spring Festival”seek。carving on the outside wall4A man in a different position.。Painted with a circular pattern near the foot。Blue and white calligraphy on both sides of the round hole in the center of the outsole“eternal”name of "four-character lucky section" radical in Chinese characters (Kangxi radical 14)。　　This bowl has a unique shape，The figure is slender and well-built，have an elegant demeanor。Blue and purple blue color，Painting of domestic green material，White glaze against richly colored blue and white decoration，It looks gorgeous and elegant.。The outer wall of this bowl is damaged by curium.，Still has a unique artistic appeal，It is a representative piece of Longqing blue and white wares in our collection.。　　Zhuge Bowl as an offering vessel，Its shape is derived from the story of the Three Kingdoms。lit. Zhu Geliang takes six steps out of Qishan (idiom); fig. collective wisdom，Sima Yi has suffered repeated defeats，close the door and not fight，Zhuge Liang repaired a letter and sent an envoy to give female clothing to Sima Yi，to motivate them to go to war。Sima Yi was not angry at all when he read the letter.，But asked Zhuge Liang in detail about his diet and living conditions。When I heard that Zhuge Liang's meal size was very small，Sima Yi said：“Eat less, but do more.，Zhu Geliang won't live long, will he?？”Zhuge Liang in order to confuse the enemy，So when the other side came to spy on us.，Deliberately eating from a double-decker bowl，On the surface it looks like you've eaten a big bowl of rice，In fact, it's only the upper floors that have food.。Later generations called this double-layered bowl the Zhuge Bowl.。
描述_ZN: Blue and white figure pattern high foot bowl, Ming Xuande, 10.2 cm high, 15.5 cm in diameter, 4.5 cm in foot diameter.　　Bowl skewed mouth, the lower abdomen inward, the lower bearing with a high foot. Bowl inner mouth painted blue double line, the inner bottom of the central blue double circle written in regular script "Da Ming Xuande year system" six characters paragraph. The outer wall of the bowl is painted with a woman enjoying the moon, a child serving on the side, complemented by landscapes, trees and rocks, and painted with cloud patterns. The foot handle painted pine, bamboo and plum pattern.　　Ming Xuande blue use imported blue material, such high iron and low manganese material in the firing process, the green material is easy to halo dispersion, so the painted decoration is not clear. This bowl is more elegant blue, the pattern is relatively clear, it is rare. Its cloud gas pattern with thick and thin line outline, this painting method on the later porcelain decoration also has influence. Ming xuande when the ceramic objects with character pattern as the theme is relatively rare, this bowl for the xuande period character pattern of the works of art.
